title: Star tracker HAT
purpose: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W add-on (uHAT) that makes a Pi and its Global Shutter Camera a star tracker: power from the spacecraft bus, RS-485 link to the flight computer, BMI088 IMU, HAT ID EEPROM

source.title: star-tracker-hat recipe
source.author: the circuit harness: blocks from Raspberry Pi, Microchip, TI, JST, Bosch documents; LED block from Mitayi-Pico (CIRCUITSTATE, MIT)
source.licence: MIT blocks; new blocks quote their datasheets

open_questions: POWER net class (VBUS, +5V): 1.0 mm traces and 0.8/0.4 mm vias are estimates; the trace width for the 3.5 A limit is not checked against a current-capacity source.
TPS2121 IN2 tied to IN1; C2/C3 values estimated; RS-485 termination value open; no TVS or fuse on the bus input (see the blocks).
Only the 40-pin socket is on the back; everything else is on top, so nothing sits over the Pi's own parts.
